rec.name: Cart Free Gift Progress Bar
rec.status: Built — A/B test set up in Ablyft (Apr 2025); result not documented

what.text: A progress bar in the cart that shows how much more the customer must spend to unlock a free gift. The bar fills as the cart value approaches a configurable minimum amount (100 in the screenshot). The gift product is shown or added once the threshold is reached. The ticket's test compares a cart without the bar against a cart with it.

why.text: A visible progress bar uses the goal-gradient effect: people accelerate as they get closer to a goal. A free gift is a concrete, high-perceived-value reward, and the remaining amount is framed as a small gap to close. This motivates customers to add items and raises AOV. The hypothesis in the ticket says the same: visible progress toward a free reward creates a psychological incentive.

how.text: The section is based on the Sectionfy.io 'CRO | Cart | Shipping-Bar' section. It was first built for the Focal theme and then reworked for the client's different theme in a duplicate theme ('A/B Test (PSY)'). That cart's Liquid does not re-render on cart updates, so the bar needed custom JavaScript hooked into the cart's own JS. This was the main effort. In Theme settings, enable the free item, set a headline and the minimum amount, and pick the gift product. To make the gift free, either duplicate the product at 0.00 and give it the 'hidden' tag so it does not appear elsewhere in the store, or use a conditional automatic discount. Then set up the A/B test (control = no bar, variant = bar) in the testing tool, which was Ablyft, and check KPI tracking in the first days.

items: Cart free gift headline (text; 'Free gift' in the screenshot)
Free gift minimum amount (number; 100 in the screenshot)
Gift products (product picker; a gift bag product in the screenshot)
Auto add (toggle; off in the screenshot) — presumably adds the gift to the cart automatically at the threshold (inferred)
Progress bar gift icon (inline SVG code field)

dependencies.text: Needs the Sectionfy.io 'CRO | Cart | Shipping-Bar' section as a base. It is theme-specific: the original was built for Focal, but the shop uses another theme with a custom cart JS, so porting needs extra work. It needs a gift product, either a duplicate priced at 0.00 with the 'hidden' tag or a conditional automatic discount. The A/B test was run in Ablyft (the tool is not required by the element itself). Currency and threshold depend on the shop (EUR, DE market).

items: Share of carts reaching the free-gift threshold

images.caption: Theme settings panel ('A/B Test (PSY)' theme) showing the Free gift configuration: Enable Free Item toggle, cart headline, minimum amount (100, circled), gift product picker, Auto add toggle and the progress bar gift-icon SVG field. The screenshot shows only the settings; the cart bar itself is not visible.
